column1: # azoth PcsaftCompositionProbe - NeqSim master's analytic `dFdN` and
# `dFdNdN` against central differences of its own `getF()` and `dFdN` at
# fixed T and V. `fd_*` rows use (plus - minus) / (2h), with `h` in moles.
# `getF()` is already extensive, so `fd_dFdN[i]` meets `dFdN[i]` and
# `fd_dFdNdN[i][j]` meets `dFdNdN[i][j]`, with no scale factor either way.
